**Event:** 52. Kongress der Deutschen Gesellschaft für Psychologie (poster presentation)\
**Location:** Hildesheim, Germany\
**Authors:** Bakaç, C., & Kehr, H. M.

## Context

Most negotiation research studies people who are already at the table. This work looked one
step earlier, at who initiates a negotiation in the first place.
